audience: sales teams and small businesses that keep parties, deals and tasks in Capsule CRM

useCases.title: Find a party and read its notes
useCases.text: Search people and organisations by name, email, phone or postcode. Read the party and its notes, emails and completed tasks.

useCases.title: Review open deals and their stages
useCases.text: List opportunities with value, expected close date and probability. Read the stages of a pipeline in order.

useCases.title: Find tasks and projects
useCases.text: List tasks, which are open by default. Pass a status to include completed or pending tasks. List the projects of the account.

useCases.title: Create a party with a deal and a task
useCases.text: Create a person or an organisation. Then create an opportunity for that party and a task on the opportunity.

useCases.title: Add a note to a party
useCases.text: Add a plain-text note to the timeline of a party. Notes are only created, never edited or deleted here.
